in_sanskrit.name: यवहर्लाल
in_sanskrit.meaning: यस्य वहर्लाल (yasya vaharlal) [of whom there is a sea or an ocean]
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jawaharlal in Sanskrit language means 'of whom there is a sea or an ocean'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'yasya' (of whom) and 'vaharlal' (there is a sea or an ocean).

in_hindi.name: जवाहरलाल
in_hindi.meaning: जवाहर (jawāhar) [manifestation, embodiment] + लाल (lāl) [red, ruddy, rosy, radiant]
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Jawaharlal in Hindi language is derived from two words - 'jawāhar' and 'lāl'. 'Jawāhar' means manifestation or embodiment, and 'lāl' means red, ruddy, rosy, or radiant. Therefore, Jawaharlal can be interpreted as 'manifestation of the radiant' or 'embodiment of the red-complexioned'.

in_marathi.name: Jawaharlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gentle, Compassionate, and Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jawaharlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jawaharlal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' (victory) and 'Hari' (God), and 'Rama' (pleasing) and 'Lalita' (playful). It symbolizes the gentle, compassionate, and brave qualities of the Hindu gods Jaya and Hari.
